Background Removal and Extraction of Only the Detection Target

records.source_section: Background Removal and Extraction of Only the Detection Target
records.evidence: KEYENCE states that background noise or other surrounding elements can cause false detections, and describes AI Target Extraction as removing sources of false detection from the surroundings.

records.source_section: AI-Based Imaging: Delivering the Best Image Quality for Detection
records.evidence: KEYENCE says AI Imaging II tests over 10,000 conditions and extracts images in which key features stand out clearly to recommend optimal images for detection.

records.source_section: AI-Based Imaging: Delivering the Best Image Quality for Detection
records.evidence: KEYENCE describes IV4 detection stability under environmental factors including slight changes in ambient lighting or surface finishes, and says AI helps configure optimal image settings.

records.source_section: Extensive Detection Tools That Simplify Previously Difficult Detection Tasks / AI Identify
records.evidence: KEYENCE states that registering a single image with AI Identify can ensure stable detection regardless of environmental changes or individual product variations.

records.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions About Vision Sensors / Is detection possible if the passing target is misaligned?
records.evidence: KEYENCE explains that misaligned products can cause false detections with point-detection sensors, while vision sensors analyze target features to determine position and orientation.

records.source_section: Frequently Asked Questions About Vision Sensors / Is detection affected by glossy surfaces?
records.evidence: KEYENCE describes false detections from glare on polished metal and states that IV4 automatic focus and brightness adjustment enable stable detection even when glare is present.

disclaimer: These metrics come from a source-grounded / weakly-supervised benchmark. Relevance labels were derived from manufacturer troubleshooting records rather than independently authored human judgments.
